say:2:1525411002:1.text: I knew the Arcane Council wouldn't just stand by while Halia suffered. You're here to put an end to this, right?
say:2:1525411002:1.source_cn: 我就知道，魔法师协会不会对呼临城的灾难坐视不理。你们一...
say:2:1525411002:1.male: I knew the Arcane Council wouldn't just stand by while Halia suffered. You're here to put an end to this, right?
say:2:1525411002:1.female: I knew the Arcane Council wouldn't just stand by while Halia suffered. You're here to put an end to this, right?

say:4:1525411003:1.text: Lord Abundius, I don't doubt <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s good intentions, but Morgan... He desecrated the bodies of our people. You can't just let that slide!
say:4:1525411003:1.male: Lord Abundius, I don't doubt <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s good intentions, but Morgan... He desecrated the bodies of our people. You can't just let that slide!
say:4:1525411003:1.female: Lord Abundius, I don't doubt <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s good intentions, but Morgan... He desecrated the bodies of our people. You can't just let that slide!

say:5:1525411004:1.text: I... I haven't forgotten! But right now, we need their help.
say:5:1525411004:1.source_cn: 我、我没忘！但是，现在呼临城需要他们的帮助。

say:8:1525411006:1.text: Don't give me that look. Whatever you think, I'm not here to explain myself.
say:8:1525411006:1.source_cn: 别瞪着我。随便你们怎么想，我都懒得解释。

say:9:1525411007:1.text: If you've got time to glare, maybe use it to fill <style="stress"><player_name></style> in on what's going on in Halia.
say:9:1525411007:1.male: If you've got time to glare, maybe use it to fill <style="stress"><player_name></style> in on what's going on in Halia.
say:9:1525411007:1.female: If you've got time to glare, maybe use it to fill <style="stress"><player_name></style> in on what's going on in Halia.

say:11:1525411008:1.text: Halia... as you can see, it's flooded again.
say:11:1525411008:1.source_cn: 呼临城……如你们所见，又一次被大雨淹没了。

say:12:1525411009:1.text: And there are more locusts every day.

say:13:1525411010:1.text: The soldiers are barely holding back the swarms outside, but the bugs just won't stop coming.
say:13:1525411010:1.source_cn: 士兵们可以勉力抵抗城外流窜的针蝗，却很难消灭无孔不入的...

say:15:1525411011:1.text: No. Every time the waters pull back, more rain falls and it's right back to square one...

say:15:1525411011:1.female: No. Every time the waters pull back, more rain falls and it's right back to square one...

say:16:1525411012:1.text: And this storm... it hasn't let up. The sky's still choked with black mist... It's like we're watching the world end!
say:16:1525411012:1.source_cn: 直到前不久开始的这场大雨，它竟然一直持续到了现在。天上...

say:16:1525411012:1.female: And this storm... it hasn't let up. The sky's still choked with black mist... It's like we're watching the world end!

choice:14:0:1.text: Has the flood receded at all?
choice:14:0:1.male: Has the flood receded at all?
choice:14:0:1.female: Has the flood receded at all?

say:17:1525411013:1.text: Thanks to the Wildborn wheat, people aren't starving anymore. But we're not out of the woods yet.
say:17:1525411013:1.source_cn: 依靠雅库伯尔分给呼临的小麦，民众们没有再忍饥挨饿，饥荒...
say:17:1525411013:1.male: Thanks to the Wildborn wheat, people aren't starving anymore. But we're not out of the woods yet.
say:17:1525411013:1.female: Thanks to the Wildborn wheat, people aren't starving anymore. But we're not out of the woods yet.

say:18:1525411014:1.text: That curse the God of Harvest put on the crops... it's still here, and we've got nothing to fight it.
say:18:1525411014:1.source_cn: 但丰饶神施加在作物种子上的诅咒依然存在，我们拿它束手无策。
say:18:1525411014:1.male: That curse the God of Harvest put on the crops... it's still here, and we've got nothing to fight it.
say:18:1525411014:1.female: That curse the God of Harvest put on the crops... it's still here, and we've got nothing to fight it.

say:19:1525411015:1.text: Even the wild plants are dying. This place is turning into a desert.
say:19:1525411015:1.source_cn: 现在，连那些生长在野外的植物受到的影响也越来越深了。整...
say:19:1525411015:1.male: Even the wild plants are dying. This place is turning into a desert.
say:19:1525411015:1.female: Even the wild plants are dying. This place is turning into a desert.

say:21:1525411016:0.text: If his power hadn't gotten stronger, he wouldn't have dared come back.
say:21:1525411016:0.source_cn: 如果不是力量更胜从前，他才不会轻易回来。
say:21:1525411016:0.male: If his power hadn't gotten stronger, he wouldn't have dared come back.
say:21:1525411016:0.female: If his power hadn't gotten stronger, he wouldn't have dared come back.

say:22:1525411017:1.text: He's already done enough damage. We can't let him wreck any more lives!
say:22:1525411017:1.source_cn: 丰饶神制造了这么多灾难，绝对不能再放任他危害更多人了！

say:23:1525411018:1.text: Please, you two have to help Halia. Help everyone suffering under the fallen god's curse!
say:23:1525411018:1.source_cn: 两位魔法师，请你们一定要帮帮呼临，帮帮所有受到神堕影响的人！

say:24:1525411019:1.text: Enough with the speeches. You think I brought <style="stress"><player_name></style> back just to chat?

say:24:1525411019:1.male: Enough with the speeches. You think I brought <style="stress"><player_name></style> back just to chat?
say:24:1525411019:1.female: Enough with the speeches. You think I brought <style="stress"><player_name></style> back just to chat?

say:25:1525411020:1.text: I'll find a way to force the God of Harvest to show himself, but when the time comes, we'll need your help.
say:25:1525411020:1.source_cn: 之后我会想办法逼丰饶神现身，到时候可能会需要你们的配合。

say:26:1525411021:1.text: For now, just keep an eye on your people in the city. Don't let anyone fall for the fallen god's tricks. That's the only thing you can do right now.
say:26:1525411021:1.source_cn: 至于现在——看好你们城内的这些人，别让谁再听信堕神的蛊...

say:28:1525411023:1.text: Let's go, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We're heading to <style="highlight">Wildborn</style> lands.
